name: Fly rug
definition: a light mesh rug (fly sheet) worn by a horse against flies.

name: Overreach boot
definition: a bell-shaped boot (bell boot) worn round a horse's pastern to protect heel and coronet.

name: Curry comb
definition: a rubber, plastic or metal comb with rows of teeth used to loosen dirt and hair from a horse's coat.

name: Lunge line
definition: a long line fixed to a horse's headgear by which it is worked in a circle round the handler.

name: Australian stock saddle
definition: a saddle of the Australian stock-riding tradition, with knee pads (poleys) and a deep seat.

name: Pack saddle
definition: a frame saddle that carries a load, not a rider, on a pack animal.

name: Aquarium air pump
definition: a pump that blows air into an aquarium through a line and air stone.

name: Aquarium water treatment
definition: a liquid or additive that conditions aquarium water (dechlorinator, bacterial starter, clarifier, algae control).

name: Bird cage
definition: a wire cage in which a pet bird is kept.

name: Bird perch
definition: a rod, branch or platform fitted in a cage for a bird to stand on.

name: Bird toy
definition: an object made for a cage bird to chew, forage, climb or play with.

name: Cage-bird feeder or drinker
definition: a cup, dish, hopper or drinker fitted to a bird cage.

name: Cage-bird nest box
definition: a nest box or nest pan fitted to a cage or aviary for breeding birds.

name: Feeder hook or bracket
definition: a hook, bracket or hanger made to hang one bird feeder.

name: Hummingbird feeder
definition: a feeder with ports that gives nectar or sugar water to hummingbirds.

name: Queen excluder
definition: a grid laid between hive boxes that keeps the queen out of the honey supers.

name: Comb foundation
definition: a wax or plastic sheet embossed with cell bases, fitted in a hive frame.

name: Varroa treatment
definition: a medicine, strip or vapour that controls varroa mites in a honey bee colony.

name: Brooder heating plate
definition: a heated plate on legs under which chicks keep warm.

name: Pet water fountain
definition: a powered bowl that circulates and filters drinking water for pets.

name: Automatic pet feeder
definition: a timed or app-controlled dispenser that releases portions of dry food for pets.

name: Driving harness
definition: the set of harness a horse, pony or donkey wears to draw a vehicle or implement: collar or breastplate, harness saddle, traces, breeching and reins.

name: Electronic pet fence
definition: a boundary-wire, wireless or GPS system that keeps a dog or cat inside a set area by signalling a receiver collar it wears.

name: Wet cat food
definition: a moist cat food in a can, pouch or tray.

name: Fresh or frozen cat food
definition: a lightly cooked or raw cat food kept chilled or frozen.

name: Cat treat
definition: a snack fed to a cat apart from its meals; complementary, not a complete diet.

name: Compound horse feed
definition: a manufactured concentrate feed for horses: pellets, cubes, coarse mix or muesli; complete or complementary is an attribute.

name: Hoof care product
definition: an oil, balm, conditioner, packing or poultice applied to a horse's hoof.

name: Horse supplement
definition: a nutritional supplement fed to a horse (joint, hoof, coat, digestive, electrolyte).

name: Hay net
definition: a net or bag of rope or mesh that holds hay for a horse to pull from.

name: Pet supplement
definition: a nutritional supplement for dogs or cats (joint, skin and coat, digestive, calming).

name: Pet shampoo or coat-care product
definition: a shampoo, conditioner, spray or wipe for cleaning a pet's coat and skin.

name: Veterinary diet (cat)
definition: food formulated for a cat's health need and sold as a diet beside dry and wet.

name: Freeze-dried or air-dried cat food
definition: dehydrated raw or cooked food made for cats.

name: Lead rope
definition: a rope or strap with a clip or snap that is fixed to a headcollar to lead or tie up a horse.
